svg.title: Phase 2, Review: one plan, parallel reviewers, one ledger
svg.desc: A diff over the cost posture's limit is planned into shards that keep coupled files together, and the couplings no shard can see are recorded as seams. A script, not a model, routes each group to a rung on a ladder, the strong model for large, coupled, or risky code, the role's own model by default, a cheaper one for a small change with no risk signal, and to an effort from low to xhigh; a retry moves one lever at a time and the posture leans every rung. Reviewers run in parallel, one per group, times the review samples, each reading only its group's diffs and the worktree; each report is saved verbatim with ids assigned, duplicates merge into the richest record, and a gap pass reads the findings and the seams and reports only what was missed, never below the reviewer's rung. Findings go on to Post; none at all means the change is clean. A finding record shows the header, the Fix, Resolution, and Check lines, and the suggestion fence a reviewer may write instead of a Fix line.
svg.text: Once, thoroughly. Judgment is spent where the change is deep, and a script decides where that is.
the orchestrating session sees one line per script
